year.era: Drop each play into the century it was written.

rows.label: Romeo and Juliet
rows.hook: follows two young lovers from feuding families whose secret marriage ends in a double tragedy

rows.label: Macbeth
rows.description: tragic play by William Shakespeare from the early 1600s
rows.hook: follows a Scottish lord driven by prophecy and ambition to murder his king

rows.label: A Midsummer Night's Dream
rows.hook: follows lovers and fairies whose romance is thrown into chaos by a mischievous sprite in an enchanted forest

rows.label: The Taming of the Shrew
rows.hook: follows a fortune-hunter who woos a sharp-tongued woman to win a bet with her father

rows.label: Othello
rows.hook: follows a general manipulated by a jealous subordinate into believing his wife is unfaithful

rows.label: Much Ado About Nothing
rows.hook: follows a witty couple tricked by friends into falling in love through overheard conversations

rows.label: King Lear
rows.hook: follows an aging ruler who divides his realm based on flattery and is betrayed by two of his daughters

rows.label: The Tempest
rows.hook: follows an exiled sorcerer who conjures a storm to strand his enemies on his island

rows.label: Twelfth Night
rows.hook: follows a shipwrecked woman who disguises herself as a man and becomes tangled in a love triangle

rows.label: The Merchant of Venice
rows.description: play by Shakespeare set in the Republic of Venice
rows.hook: follows a moneylender who demands a pound of flesh as collateral when a loan goes unpaid

rows.label: As You Like It
rows.hook: follows a young woman who flees to a forest disguised as a boy after her uncle seizes power

rows.label: Julius Caesar
rows.hook: follows Roman senators who assassinate their leader to stop him becoming a tyrant

rows.label: Titus Andronicus
rows.hook: follows a Roman general drawn into a spiral of revenge after his family is wronged

rows.label: Richard III
rows.hook: follows a scheming duke who manipulates his way to the English throne through betrayal and murder

rows.label: The Comedy of Errors
rows.hook: follows two sets of separated twins whose reunion in one city causes a day of mistaken identities

rows.label: Antony and Cleopatra
rows.hook: follows a Roman general whose love for an Egyptian queen leads both to their downfall

rows.label: Love's Labour's Lost
rows.hook: follows a king and his lords who swear off romance for a year and then fall for a group of visiting noblewomen

rows.label: Coriolanus
rows.hook: follows a proud Roman general banished by his own city who then leads an enemy army against it

rows.label: The Winter's Tale
rows.hook: follows a jealous ruler whose false accusation shatters his family for years before an unlikely reunion
